audit_scope.description: Trust model for Prague fork transaction types, Osaka fork meta-specification, Prague VM memory operations, EIP-758 (transaction completion subscriptions), and Prague stack operations.
in_scope: Prague fork typed transaction processing and validation
Osaka fork block validation and peer communication
Prague VM memory cost and expansion operations
EIP-758 JSON-RPC subscription interface for transaction completion

misclassified_entities.reason: Opcode execution is triggered internally by the EVM during contract execution, not by an external entity.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Transaction submitters are unauthenticated; Prague-typed transactions must be validated against new type envelope rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Data Source
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External data sources providing transaction payloads are untrusted; all data must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Proposer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Block proposers submit blocks containing Osaka fork features; blocks received over P2P are untrusted.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Network peers propagating Osaka fork blocks are unauthenticated P2P participants.

trusted_external_entities.name: DApp Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: DApp clients subscribing to transaction completion events are unauthenticated RPC consumers.

trusted_external_entities.name: HTTP Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: HTTP clients polling for transaction results are unauthenticated external consumers.

boundary_edges.data_crossing_boundary: Osaka fork blocks with new features
Subscription requests for transaction completion notifications

gaps: Prague stack operations (EIP spec) are purely internal EVM operations with no external entity interactions.
Prague VM memory spec had misclassified internal opcode caller as external.
